displayRotationConvention: Positive world Y, anticlockwise viewed from overhead with north at -Z.
displayBasis: Actors, weapons, contacts, trails and effects rotate together; DOM projection and cutaway targets use the same transform. Physics stays in its existing world frame.

coverage: fixed display basis across visible roots and HUD projection
cutaway rays target the displayed fighters
central fighter and most-floor framing over desktop resize

chrome.rematch: verified same mode, loadouts and framing after reset

knownFramingLimits: Foreground and side-rim fighters or weapons can leave the tighter static frame.
Reviewed floor-area crop is about 9.5% at aspect1.5 and 6.2% at aspect1.8; central framing is not an all-pose visibility guarantee.
historicalPreviewPreservation: Pinned original camera inputs and disabled production display basis before fixture-specific transforms.
gitDelivery: No commit, push, merge or release.
